lede: Approximate tax savings from apron-driven moves. The second apron doesn't just charge money — it bans the mid-level exception, salary aggregation, and future pick trades, so teams are shedding stars to get under it.
og_desc: Klay walked, PG walked, KAT was dumped, Boston tore apart a title team. The new cap ends dynasties faster than money ever did.
og_title: The second apron broke up contenders in two seasons

title: The second apron ended dynasties faster than the luxury tax ever did
tldr: Klay Thompson and Paul George walked for nothing, KAT was salary-dumped, and Boston tore apart a title team one summer later — the new cap broke up contenders in two seasons.
